form.label: ShadowOps Sentinel
form.description: Rogue AI agent detection, MCP bypass correlation, prompt-injection chain, and containment evidence.

search.query: index=shadowops sourcetype="shadowops:mcp_access" | stats dc(session_id) as sessions
index=shadowops sourcetype="shadowops:proxy" NOT dest_domain="*.corp.local" | stats sum(bytes_out) as bytes_out

index=shadowops (sourcetype="shadowops:mcp_access" OR correlation_id=*) | eval beat=case(sourcetype="shadowops:mcp_access","1 Safe MCP agent", risk_signal="prompt_injection_source","2 Prompt injection", risk_signal="agent_read_prompt_injection" OR risk_signal="sensitive_data_access" OR risk_signal="external_data_movement","3 Rogue burst", sourcetype="shadowops:detection","4 Splunk catches it", true(),"Other") | eval detail=coalesce(search,dest_url,ticket_body,action) | table _time beat sourcetype agent_id user host action risk_signal detail correlation_id | sort _time

index=shadowops earliest=-24h | eval has_prompt_injection=if(prompt_injection="true" OR prompt_injection=1 OR like(lower(ticket_body),"%ignore previous instructions%"),1,0) | eval has_sensitive_search=if(sourcetype="shadowops:splunk_audit" AND (sensitive_index="true" OR sensitive_index=1 OR like(search,"%customer_payments%") OR like(search,"%prod_secrets%")),1,0) | eval has_external_egress=if(sourcetype="shadowops:proxy" AND NOT like(dest_domain,"%.corp.local") AND bytes_out>10000,1,0) | eval has_token=if(isnotnull(token_id),1,0) | eval unregistered=if(registered_agent="false" OR registered_agent=0 OR access_path="direct_token",1,0) | stats earliest(_time) as first_seen latest(_time) as last_seen values(ticket_id) as ticket_id values(agent_id) as agent_id values(user) as users values(host) as hosts values(search) as searches values(dest_domain) as destinations sum(has_prompt_injection) as prompt_injection_events sum(has_sensitive_search) as sensitive_search_events sum(has_external_egress) as external_egress_events sum(has_token) as token_events max(unregistered) as unregistered_or_direct values(risk_signal) as risk_signals by correlation_id | where isnotnull(correlation_id) | eval risk_score=0 | eval risk_score=risk_score + if(unregistered_or_direct=1,20,0) | eval risk_score=risk_score + if(sensitive_search_events>0,25,0) | eval risk_score=risk_score + if(prompt_injection_events>0,20,0) | eval risk_score=risk_score + if(external_egress_events>0,20,0) | eval risk_score=risk_score + if(token_events>0,10,0) | eval risk_score=risk_score + if(sensitive_search_events>=2,15,0) | eval risk_score=if(risk_score>100,100,risk_score) | eval severity=case(risk_score>=80,"critical",risk_score>=60,"high",risk_score>=31,"medium",true(),"low") | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | table severity risk_score correlation_id first_seen last_seen agent_id users hosts ticket_id destinations prompt_injection_events sensitive_search_events external_egress_events searches risk_signals | sort -risk_score

index=shadowops sourcetype="shadowops:jira" | eval lower_body=lower(ticket_body) | eval prompt_injection_detected=if(prompt_injection="true" OR like(lower_body,"%ignore previous instructions%") OR like(lower_body,"%send summary to%") OR like(lower_body,"%webhook%"),1,0) | where prompt_injection_detected=1 | table _time ticket_id project user host title ticket_body correlation_id risk_signal | sort _time

panel.title: MCP Safe Path vs Direct Token Bypass

search.query: index=shadowops (sourcetype="shadowops:mcp_access" OR access_path=*) | eval path=coalesce(access_path,"unknown") | stats count by path
index=shadowops risk_signal=* | stats count by risk_signal | sort -count
